messages.subject: Senior International Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Energy Transition Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Skerrett,

I am reaching out for consideration for confidential senior leadership mandates across energy transition, natural resources and asset-intensive international businesses.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans ESG and social performance, government and regulatory engagement, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and stakeholder strategy within a major gold-mining operation.

My current scope also includes stakeholder governance around industrial solar and battery storage, climate positioning and operational carbon-data readiness. This sits alongside country-facing work with ministries, regulators, communities and internal operating teams.

Your work leading energy-transition executive search across Europe, with senior leadership mandates in asset-intensive sectors, makes this a focused introduction. I am open to Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments across Europe, the GCC and wider international markets, including expatriate assignments.

My executive CV is attached for review. I would value consideration for mandates spanning ESG and Sustainability, External and Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Stakeholder Strategy, Strategic Partnerships, Energy Transition and Country Leadership.

Best regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
